gates.interpretation: Critical or high advisories block publication; moderate and low advisories remain visible.
gates.escalation: Upgrade or replace the affected dependency, then rerun the report.
gates.limitation: Mermaid remains pinned at 11.4.1 with 9 advisory findings; review before changing the tested compatibility pair.

gates.interpretation: Every distributed dependency must use an approved permissive or weak-copyleft license.
gates.escalation: Identify an SPDX license or replace the dependency; do not publish an unknown license.

gates.interpretation: No dynamic code execution or document.write is permitted in rendering paths.
gates.escalation: Treat a finding as a security issue and add a regression test before release.

gates.interpretation: SVG is parsed in the SVG namespace and interpolated labels are XML-escaped.
gates.escalation: Block release and add a browser regression for any unsafe injection path.

gates.interpretation: Automated SVG semantics and control-name assertions must pass; manual AT review remains separate.
gates.escalation: Block the accessibility claim and record missing browser/assistive-technology evidence.

gates.interpretation: Browser claims are limited to engines actually run; Linux/Chromium is not cross-platform proof.
gates.escalation: Run the Firefox/WebKit matrix with native dependencies or narrow the public compatibility claim.
gates.limitation: This report records Linux/Chromium evidence only; Firefox, WebKit, Windows, and assistive technology are not inferred.

gates.interpretation: Every external notation and research claim on the public comparison page must retain an inspectable source link.
gates.escalation: Restore the missing source link or remove the unsupported comparison claim before release.

gates.interpretation: The lockfile, declared package manager, generated assets, and build must reproduce from a clean checkout.
gates.escalation: Regenerate and commit the lockfile/generated assets or stop publication.

releaseBoundary: Static browser-first descriptive BPMN subset; no backend, accounts, telemetry, or executable BPMN semantics.
